note: Adapted from Hill's (1942) species-level description, the original in English. The original used the old combination Mirotermes insignitus, now placed in Australitermes. The type locality is given in the original as Wauchope Well (about 75 miles south of Tennant's Creek), which differs from 'Wauchope Creek' recorded in the grouping checklist; the two are variant spellings of the same place name. The original has an alate description only, with no soldier or worker section. The forewing width is missing in the OCR and no figure has been supplied.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The original (Hill 1942) published it as Mirotermes (Mirotermes) insignitus, described from the alate alone; the type specimen was collected at Wauchope Well, Northern Territory (about 75 miles south of Tennant's Creek), taken at light in October (month 10). It is closely related to and clearly distinct from M. percomis: the latter is larger, darker, distinctly less hairy, and the shape of the pronotum is also clearly different.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: A medium-sized, yellowish-brown, very hairy species; wings pale smoky; antennae long; compound eyes and ocelli very large. Head (Fig. 316) very short and broadly rounded behind the compound eyes, narrowed anteriorly, flat between the lateral ocelli. Postclypeus strongly inflated, length slightly more than half its width; anteclypeus large, distinctly projecting in the middle. Compound eyes and ocelli very prominent; ocelli broadly elliptical, length greater than width by one-fifth. Mandibles as in Fig. 317. Fontanelle small, linear. Antennae 15- or 16-segmented; segment 1 very large, twice as long as segment 2; segments 3 and 4 subequal in length and as long as segment 2, closely fused, or segments 2 and 5 the shortest of the whole antenna; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4; segment 5 about equal to segment 4, or shorter than segment 4; segment 6 and following segments long, the terminal segment cylindrical, broadly rounded at the apex. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin wavy, anterolateral angles narrow, the sides sharply narrowed to the shallowly concave posterior margin. Posterior margin of mesonotum wider and shallowly concave; posterior margin of metanotum much narrower but likewise concave. Measurements: length with wings 9.50 (the original OCR reads '9-50'); length without wings 4.50—4.70; head length (to apex of labrum) 1.00—1.06; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.60—0.66; head width 0.93—0.95; maximum diameter of compound eye 0.33; ocellus length 0.18; pronotum length 0.47—0.51; pronotum width 0.80—0.88; forewing length 8.00—8.50; forewing width: this item is missing in the OCR (the original is cut off where it continues onto the caption of the next page) and could not be read.
